title: LLM Observability
description: LLM API request/response plane, parsed by the nginx lua capture (body-capture.lua). Request view (llm-request-body-*): the OpenAI-compatible payload per POST. Response view (llm-response-body-*): the completion object per request — an SSE stream is reconstructed into the chat.completion shape, so usage tokens and content are queryable either way. Instance = upstream_addr ip:port (llama-server 8001-8004 behind app.llm.lan).
